title: A Muslim is tidy
intro: Allah loves tidiness – in our body, our clothes, our home and everything we do.

learn.html: Besides keeping our home and yard clean, Islam asks Muslims to keep their body and clothes tidy, and to be tidy in everything they do. Tidiness includes cleanliness, and adds beauty and order to how we dress and behave – at home and wherever we work. Allah loves tidiness, so He commanded Muslims to be tidy.

learn.title: The Prophet (SAW) was always tidy
learn.html: The Prophet (SAW) was an example of tidiness in every way. With his tidiness he won the hearts of strangers, and they accepted Islam. ‘A’ishah (RA) said: “I never saw Allah’s Messenger untidy. He sometimes used oil on his hair, combed it regularly, and said: ‘Allah does not love dirt and untidiness.’” (Bayhaqi)

items: staying away every day from everything that is improper

learn.html: We must get used to tidiness from childhood. The believers will be rewarded by Allah for tidiness in this world and the next.

Allah loves tidiness and cleanliness,
so be like that at home and school.
What is tidiness? you often ask –
the answer is short: everything in its place.

When you get up in the morning, get going:
visit the bathroom and make your bed.
Books, notebooks and pencils know their place,
trainers and shoes are shining bright.

At home and at school, at maktab and in the park,
I’ll be like that at every step.
Why will I be tidy? To make my parents happy –
the Prophet said: if your parent is pleased with you, Jannah is yours.
(English translation)

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: I may not have great wealth, but I am clean and tidy!
